items.title: Uber Expands Costco Delivery To 47 States, Nearly 600 Locations In Major Grocery Push
items.summary: Costco is giving customers more flexibility to shop its warehouse selection through Uber Eats.

items.title: Costco and Uber Eats Expand US Delivery Partnership to Nearly 600 Locations
items.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) and Costco Wholesale (NASDAQ:COST) have expanded their US delivery partnership to 47 states, up from 17, making nearly 600 Costco locations available through the Uber Eats platform. The companies said the expanded service allows Costco members to place orders for on-demand or scheduled delivery through the Uber Eats app.
